Row.Text: On a river floodplain, a rectangular foundation of red brick takes shape on the grass. A wooden crane lifts materials as scaffolding surrounds the rising walls and thick dust billows from the construction site. The entire site rotates as the scaffolding disappears to reveal the Great Bath. The finished brick complex features a sunken central pool, blue painted accents, and four corner towers capped with small gold domes. As daylight fades to night, the water in the main pool glows with a bright blue light and warm yellow illumination spills from the doorways of the small surrounding outbuildings.

Beside a river in a city, a flat square foundation appears on a patch of green land. Gray stone walls and pillars rise from the dirt, built with the help of wooden scaffolding and treadwheel cranes. The structure grows into a large stepped ziggurat with multiple terraced levels. As the stonework reaches its peak, the walls take on a warm yellow hue, finished with bright blue tiles and golden accents on the upper tiers. Lush green trees and bushes sprout across every terrace, covering the stone monument in dense foliage. Tall pillars around the base and braziers on the balconies ignite with bright flames, casting a warm glow over the gardens as dusk settles over the landscape.

On flat ground next to a stone quarry, wooden sleds and log rollers appear on the grass. Large gray stones are dragged into place and raised upright using wooden scaffolding and ramps. An inner horseshoe of tall trilithons goes up first, as horizontal lintels are placed across the tops of the uprights. An outer circle of standing stones and lintels is then constructed around the horseshoe. The wooden scaffolding disappears, leaving the completed stone circle standing alone on the grass. Shadows sweep across the ground as the sun passes overhead, and the view circles the ancient monument.

Wooden posts mark a dirt patch beside a hunting camp. Stone blocks build a rectangular foundation while wooden cranes and scaffolding surround the site. A stepped base of white marble rises to support a perimeter of tall columns and a pitched roof covered in red tiles. Several smaller buildings with matching red roofs and white columns emerge around the central structure. The sun sets and casts long shadows across the surrounding land. Warm golden light illuminates the completed Temple of Artemis against the darkening evening sky.

On a marshy river floodplain, a massive square foundation takes shape in the dim light of dawn. Wooden scaffolding and cranes surround the site as a towering ziggurat rises tier by tier. Dust billows from the construction while the morning sun casts a warm glow over the structure. The view sweeps around the building as workers construct a monumental central staircase and paint the broad exterior walls a vibrant blue. A small temple crowns the flat summit of the pyramid. The scaffolding falls away to reveal the completed Etemenanki, flanked by small outbuildings and palm trees at its base.

On a sandy desert plain by a river, scattered stone blocks mark the beginning of construction. A square foundation takes shape, and a massive structure rises in stepped layers with the help of wooden scaffolding and earthen ramps. The rough steps are covered with a smooth, pale stone casing that reaches up to a golden capstone. Beside the main monument, a second large pyramid and three smaller ones emerge from the sand. Two tall obelisks rise to the left, while golden statues flank an entrance decorated with blue trim. The view sweeps around the completed Pyramids as bright sunlight casts deep shadows across the desert.

On a coastal water tile next to the city's harbor, a large square stone base takes shape on a rocky island, surrounded by wooden scaffolding and cranes. A tall square tower rises from the base, followed by an octagonal middle section and a cylindrical top. A golden statue crowns the summit as the scaffolding falls away to reveal the finished Great Lighthouse. The light-colored stone structure features a ramp leading to the entrance and four statues of Triton at the corners of the square tier. As evening approaches, the view sweeps around the structure while long shadows stretch across the water and a bright fire glows from the lantern room beneath the dome.

The construction begins on hills within a city, as wooden cranes and scaffolding form a wide circle over bare dirt. Dust billows while stone foundations spread into concentric retaining walls and staircases. A ring of white stone columns rises on a central platform, and a second tier of pillars forms above them. A tiered conical roof caps the central temple before the wooden construction frames vanish. Tall cypress trees sprout around the base of the finished Oracle just as the sunlight shifts. A golden glow washes over the white stone and casts long shadows across the grass.

A stone terrace takes shape on an empty plot within the capital city. Thick walls and four square corner towers rise from the platform amidst wooden scaffolding and clouds of dust. Tall, slender columns emerge to form a vast central hall and three open porticoes facing outward. A flat, dark roof covers the structure and casts deep shadows between the columns in the late afternoon sun. The finished palace stands complete with wide staircases leading up to the grand entrances on the elevated base. The view circles the massive stone complex as twilight approaches.

On flat ground beside an entertainment district, a circular wooden frame marks the footprint of the Colosseum. Stone foundations form concentric rings, and wooden cranes lift blocks to build the first tier of arches. Scaffolding surrounds the rising walls as the second and third tiers of arched arcades take shape. The view revolves around the amphitheater while the solid fourth tier goes up. As the wooden scaffolding falls away, a red canvas awning extends over the upper rim to shade the seating inside. The completed stone arena stands tall under the bright sun, casting a long shadow across the grass.

A circular stone platform appears on a rocky island beside the shore, next to the city harbor. Wooden scaffolding rises around the base as construction begins. A giant bronze statue takes shape inside the framework, starting with the feet and legs before the torso and head emerge. The scaffolding disappears to reveal the completed Colossus. The towering figure wears a spiked crown, holds a tall spear in its right hand, and drapes a cloak over its left arm. Bright sunlight gleams on the polished bronze metal and casts a long shadow across the water.

On flat ground beside a scholarly campus, wooden scaffolding and tall cranes appear. A large rectangular foundation of light stone blocks takes shape. The stone walls rise to form a sprawling complex with a circular structure in the center. As the sun sets and casts long shadows, a domed roof tops the central drum and sloped roofs cover the rectangular wings. The scaffolding vanishes as torches and braziers ignite around the exterior walls and the grand entrance. The completed Great Library stands illuminated in the twilight, glowing warmly against the darkening blue landscape.

A massive, flat-topped mesa of red sandstone stands among hills within a city. In the fading light of dusk, wooden scaffolding and a tall crane appear at the base of the steep rock face. The view circles the mesa as dust rises and a rectangular temple grows directly against the stone cliff, its walls forming an entrance flanked by thick columns. In front of the temple, three steep pyramids emerge from the sandy ground. The scaffolding vanishes, and warm light illuminates the temple facade and the golden capstones of the pyramids against the darkening night sky.

A steep mountain stands within a city. Tall wooden scaffolding surrounds the rocky crag as thick stone retaining walls encircle the slopes. The walls form stepped terraces that fill with dark earth and bright green grass. Higher up the peak, stone walls emerge to form a complex of interconnected buildings and open plazas. Steep gabled roofs cap the structures, completing the high-altitude estate. As the sun sets, warm yellow light glows from the windows and doorways of the stone buildings.

A square stone foundation appears around a single green tree in a forest next to a holy site. A red brick wall encloses the area as a wide square base takes shape in front of the tree. Wooden scaffolding surrounds a central tower that grows upward in stacked tiers. Four smaller towers emerge at the corners of the base and match the shape of the main structure. The scaffolding falls away to reveal the completed Mahabodhi Temple, a tall pyramidal monument covered in horizontal bands of carvings. The sun sets and casts a warm golden light over the stone, while small lights illuminate the courtyard around the sacred tree.

At night, a rectangular foundation is laid on a grassy plot beside a city harbor. As the sun rises and casts long shadows, wooden scaffolding and cranes assemble a massive square podium of pale stone. Above the podium, tall pillars form a surrounding Ionic colonnade. A stepped pyramidal roof ascends over the pillars to cap the monument. The structure is crowned with a large bronze statue of a four-horse chariot. As dusk falls, the scaffolding disappears and the completed Mausoleum at Halicarnassus stands illuminated by glowing braziers at its corners and blazing torches along the lower walls.

A jagged hill of red sandstone stands within a city on a desert floodplain. Wooden scaffolding surrounds the rock as dust clouds billow from the summit. The stone is carved away from the top down to reveal the upper level of a detailed facade. A broken pediment and a central cylindrical tholos emerge from the rock face before the carving continues downward to form a row of tall columns and a large entrance at the base. The scaffolding falls away to leave the finished Treasury carved into the cliff. Bright sunlight illuminates the rose-red stone as the view sweeps around the monument.

Morning mist clears from a flat plot beside a military encampment as wooden cranes raise a rectangular stone foundation. A stepped base forms, and scaffolding supports a perimeter of white columns. Inside the colonnade, the solid walls of the cella rise to enclose a massive seated statue of Zeus. A pitched roof with red tiles caps the temple, leaving a rectangular opening over the statue to let sunlight pour into the sanctuary. The view sweeps around to the front entrance as late afternoon shadows lengthen. Two tall braziers burn atop stone pillars flanking the wide front steps, while the decorated pediment completes the classical facade.

On flat grassland next to a military encampment, wooden cranes and scaffolding surround a newly excavated rectangular pit. Rows of clay soldiers materialize inside the excavation. A wooden pavilion with a raised central platform and stairs rises over the pit. As the scaffolding comes down, ranks of terracotta warriors holding spears and red banners assemble around the outside of the building. The pavilion is finished with dark roofs and red trim. The sun sets, and torches illuminate the silent army standing guard around the site.

At dawn on a grassy hill next to a military encampment, a wooden crane lifts materials to begin construction. Stone foundations outline a large rectangular complex, and wooden scaffolding rises to support stone columns. Thick walls of reddish-brown stone grow in stages, forming a fortress with the massive Comares Tower on one side and smaller towers at the corners. Inside the walls, the Court of the Lions emerges, featuring a small central fountain surrounded by arcades. Red tile roofs cover the buildings as the scaffolding disappears. The completed Alhambra stands bathed in bright morning sunlight, casting long shadows across the hillside.

In the dark of night, a rectangular stone foundation takes shape within a city next to an aqueduct. Gray stone blocks stack to form an outer gallery and a stepped inner pyramid. Wooden scaffolding clings to the rising walls as five towers emerge from the upper tier. The central tower climbs higher than the four corner towers. As the sun rises, the scaffolding falls away to reveal golden, lotus-bud spires capping each tower. The morning light warms the gray stone to a rich golden-brown, and golden statues flank the entrances of Angkor Wat.

In a clearing within the rainforest, a square stone foundation takes shape. Wooden scaffolding surrounds the site as a stepped pyramid rises tier by tier. The structure grows to form nine distinct terraces, with steep staircases climbing the center of each of its four sides. As the scaffolding disappears, a square temple with a dark doorway is completed at the flat summit. The sun sets, casting long shadows across the pale stone. Night falls, and bright torches illuminate the base of the staircases and the entrance to the temple above.

On a flat plot next to a city's holy site, wooden scaffolding outlines a large rectangular foundation. Thick brick walls rise to form a massive square base with arched windows. Wooden cranes lift materials as a large central dome takes shape, surrounded by smaller half-domes. The domes are clad in slate blue, contrasting with the pinkish-tan stone of the walls. Four slender white minarets, each topped with a blue conical roof and a crescent finial, rise at the corners of the complex. As the construction finishes, the sun sets, casting long shadows across the ground and bathing the building in warm evening light.

At night, wooden posts are driven into the dark water of a lake near the shore to form a wide circle. A wooden palisade wall encloses the ring, and a flat wooden platform is laid inside it with a short bridge connecting to the land. Stone foundations cover the platform as a stepped pyramid rises tier by tier within wooden scaffolding. Two wide staircases are built side by side up the front face of the pyramid, leading to two small temples with peaked roofs on the flat summit. As the sun rises, the scaffolding disappears to reveal the completed Huey Teocalli bathed in bright morning light.

On a coastal site, a rectangular foundation is laid out for a sprawling palace complex. Thick tan stone walls rise to form a large, multi-story main building decorated with blue trim. A wooden crane lifts materials as a tall central tower grows and receives a bright blue dome. Crenellated outer walls enclose a courtyard around the base of the palace. Two fortified rectangular annexes with open courtyards are constructed extending out into the water. As dusk falls, warm light glows from the arched doorways and windows of the finished stone structure.

Next to a city's holy site, a raised stone platform emerges with a wide set of stairs. Wooden scaffolding and a crane erect a square framework of pillars around a circular central base. A massive bronze statue of a seated Buddha rises piece by piece on the base. As evening falls, a large wooden hall with a tiled roof rises to completely enclose the statue. The hall suddenly vanishes, leaving the Great Buddha sitting in the open air. Under the night sky, glowing lanterns illuminate four small wooden pavilions at the corners of the platform, while pink cherry blossom trees bloom around the base.

Within a city next to a holy site, workers lay a rectangular stone foundation. Wooden scaffolding and a crane rise to support the construction of a massive, multi-tiered tower. As the structure climbs higher, the tiers step inward to form a steep pyramidal shape. The view sweeps around the site as the sun sets, casting long shadows and bathing the temple in warm light. The scaffolding falls away to reveal the finished Meenakshi Temple, its vibrant red, gold, and white facade covered in intricate carvings. A barrel-vaulted roof with golden finials crowns the towering gopuram, while smaller shrines flank its base.

A rocky hill rises from a marshy floodplain. Wooden scaffolding surrounds the base of the mound as stone ramparts and tall buildings take shape. The construction climbs higher up the slope, forming a dense cluster of walls and arched windows. At the summit, a large abbey emerges with a steep roof and a tall central spire. The wooden frames disappear as the final turrets and a golden statue at the very top complete the structure. The sun sets, and warm yellow light glows from the many windows of Mont St. Michel, illuminating the towering silhouette against the dark landscape.

On a desert tile beside a city campus, the University of Sankore begins as a rectangular outline of pillars. Thick mudbrick walls rise to connect the pillars and enclose a central courtyard. As night turns to day, a stepped base takes shape within the walls. A tall, pyramidal minaret climbs on one side of the structure, while a shorter tower rises on the opposite side. Wooden beams protrude from the smooth, tan mudbrick faces of the towers and walls. The view sweeps around the completed mosque, which stands bathed in bright sunlight.

A square foundation appears on an empty plot next to a government plaza. Wooden scaffolding and tall wooden cranes rise as thick stone walls are laid. Red brick walls grow upward to form a hollow square around a central courtyard. A flat roof covers the first two stories before a third level is added with white stone trim, rows of windows and small corner spires. The construction gear vanishes to reveal the finished structure with a small fountain in front. As the sun sets and shadows fall across the city, warm light glows from the windows of the building and illuminates the splashing fountain.

On a flat plot next to a city center, a rectangular stone foundation appears in the early morning light. Wooden scaffolding rises to outline a large central pavilion and several smaller surrounding halls. Cranes lift materials into place as solid red walls enclose the complex and form the structures within. Golden yellow roofs with curved eaves cap the buildings, completing the Forbidden City. A main gate stands at the front of the enclosure, leading into the open courtyards. The sun climbs higher, casting sharp shadows across the grounds and illuminating the vibrant red and gold architecture of the walled palace.

Beside grazing cattle and a commercial district, a small fire burns on an empty patch of grass. Wooden scaffolding forms a large oval, and thick stone walls rise within the framework. As the scaffolding comes down, a second ring of walls takes shape inside the first. A tall conical tower of dry stone grows within the inner courtyard alongside a leafy tree. Small round huts with yellow thatched roofs appear inside the enclosure and cluster around the outer grey walls. The finished Great Zimbabwe stands in the twilight as a large fire blazes brightly in the central courtyard.

Beside a river in a city, a large rectangular foundation is laid out on the ground. A steel framework rises from the foundation, outlining a symmetrical building with a central dome and two long wings. Stone walls fill in the framework as the sun rises, casting long morning shadows. The central dome is capped with a ribbed, dark red roof, while smaller spires and turrets are added to the wings and the main facade. The completed Országház stands as a wide Gothic Revival structure with detailed stonework and a tall central dome. Late afternoon light casts long shadows across the finished building, revealing statues on pedestals flanking a paved plaza and a rectangular reflecting pool near the riverbank.

Spanning a narrow strip of land between two bodies of water, the concrete Gatun and Miraflores locks face each other across a snowy gap. Construction cranes move in to excavate the earth between them. Dust rises as thick concrete walls are built to connect the two halves. Once the trench is complete, support buildings and storage tanks appear along the banks. Water floods into the new channel as daylight fades to dusk. Finally, red steel towers rise over the waterway to form a suspension bridge that lights up in the twilight.

Beside a city center, a square foundation is marked on the ground. A white stone base is laid, and wooden scaffolding and a crane appear. Red brick walls rise, forming a tall central tower surrounded by a cluster of smaller chapels. Green roofs cover the lower sections, and the towers are crowned with vibrant onion domes in swirling patterns of blue, white, red, and green, while the central tower bears a golden dome. The scaffolding falls away as the sun sets and shadows lengthen. The completed St. Basil's Cathedral stands brightly illuminated, its colorful domes glowing against the dark night.

A square patch of bare earth appears beside a river in a city, and a low red wall forms the boundary of a raised platform. Wooden scaffolding surrounds the rising walls of a massive white marble mausoleum. A large central dome and four smaller domes take shape on the roof, while four tall minarets rise at the corners of the platform. The scaffolding falls away to reveal the completed structure with its arched entrances and intricate facades. As daylight fades into deep night, bright lights illuminate the white marble walls from below, and red beacons glow at the peak of each minaret.

In the dark water just off the coast, a sweeping beam of light illuminates stone foundations as they form the shape of a hexagonal bastion and a square base. Wooden scaffolding goes up as the thick walls of the bastion rise, complete with a line of cannon ports. Behind the bastion, the square tower climbs higher within its wooden framework. As the scaffolding disappears, the sun rises to bathe the completed white stone fortress in warm light. The flat terrace of the bastion and the roof of the four-story tower both feature small domed watchtowers at their corners. The view circles the finished structure as it stands guard beside the city harbor.

A stone foundation emerges from the shallow coastal waters beside an industrial shore. Thick walls rise to form a large enclosed harbor with rectangular basins. Wooden scaffolding surrounds the growing structure while the arches and pillars of two large drydocks take shape in brick and white stone. Gabled roofs with red clay tiles cover the main boatyards and the surrounding workshops. The view sweeps around the completed Venetian Arsenal as the sun sets and casts a warm orange glow across the masonry. Night falls and warm yellow lights illuminate the arched entrances and the inner canals of the complex.

On a rocky hill next to snow-capped mountains, wooden scaffolding rises in tiers along the slope. Sloping stone walls form within the timber frames to create the broad wings of the White Palace. As the structure climbs higher, the crimson walls of the central Red Palace emerge between the white outer sections. The sun dips lower in the sky, casting long shadows across the terrain as the scaffolding falls away. Golden roof pavilions appear atop the flat roofs of the finished complex. The vast Potala Palace stands complete, its bright white and deep red facades glowing in the warm light of the late afternoon.

On an empty plot beside a city's theater district, a wooden framework rises and fills with stone blocks to form a large rectangular hall. The structure gains a pitched roof as the sun comes up, and scaffolding wraps the front facade while workers construct a massive portico with eight columns. The exterior is finished in white and pale blue, topped by a triangular pediment and a bronze sculpture of a man driving a chariot pulled by four horses. A plaza with a circular fountain and curving paths is laid out before the building. As night falls, tall cypress trees grow around the plaza, warm yellow light shines from the windows of the Bolshoi Theatre, and the fountain glows blue.

On flat land beside a city campus, a circular foundation appears in the twilight. As daylight breaks, wooden scaffolding rises to frame a central rotunda and flanking rectangular wings. Stone walls fill in the frames to form the sprawling complex. A large dome caps the central rotunda, the Radcliffe Camera, while the surrounding buildings gain steep blue roofs and ornate spires. The scaffolding vanishes to reveal the finished structures. Evening falls, and warm light glows from the many arched windows across the stone facades.

Beside a river next to a city's industrial zone, construction begins at dusk on a patch of grass. A rectangular foundation appears, followed by a rising grid of steel scaffolding. Within this framework, a massive red steel headframe takes shape, tapering toward the top where a large winding wheel is installed, while red brick buildings with tall smokestacks are constructed around its base. As morning light breaks, the scaffolding disappears to reveal the completed coal mine complex. Thick smoke billows from the chimneys, and a railway track leads directly into the facility as the view sweeps around the towering red structure.

A star-shaped foundation sits on a small island in the coastal waters just off a city shore. As the sun rises over the water, a tall stone pedestal takes shape on the star. An iron framework goes up on the pedestal, and a copper skin covers the frame to form a robed woman holding a tablet and a raised torch. Night falls over the harbor and red fireworks explode in the sky around the monument. When the smoke clears, the statue stands bathed in the light of bright spotlights. The copper skin now shows a pale green patina, and the torch glows yellow against the dark water.

Within a city beside a river and a commercial district, wooden posts appear on a snowy patch of ground. A large timber framework rises, with a tall tower structure extending high on one corner. Scaffolding surrounds the frame as light stone walls fill in the lower levels and the tower gains its four large clock faces and a pointed roof. The scaffolding comes down to reveal a sprawling gothic palace with rows of arched windows. As daylight fades into night, the four clock faces illuminate with a bright white glow. Warm yellow light shines from the many windows across the dark stone facade.

A tower crane stands on a patch of bare dirt in a city beside a river. Wooden posts mark the footprint before stone foundations form a large rectangle with an inner courtyard. Scaffolding surrounds a rising steel frame before solid stone walls enclose the building. The facade turns light blue with white columns and window trims, and a green roof covers the structure. As the scaffolding comes down, the red granite Alexander Column rises in the front plaza. The sun sets and twilight falls, illuminating the windows of the completed Hermitage as the view circles the massive palace.

On a snowy plot next to a city campus, wooden poles are driven into the frozen ground. A steel framework rises upon the poles, and a tall crane lifts materials to build an elevated main structure. The frame is enclosed with dark walls and rows of windows. A large radar dome is placed on the flat roof, while a smaller dome and two cylindrical tanks appear on the snow below. As dusk turns to night, bright lights illuminate the station's windows, casting a warm glow across the dark landscape.

On a flat plot next to a city theater district, steel frameworks rise to form the skeletons of several tall buildings. Scaffolding surrounds the structures as brown and gray facades fill in the frames. The buildings reach their full height, taking the shape of a dense cluster of stone and brick skyscrapers. As construction finishes, the sun sets and twilight falls over the city. Suddenly, bright neon signs illuminate the facades in red, blue, white and yellow light. Spotlights shine upwards from the street and sweep across the dark sky, transforming Broadway into a glowing entertainment hub.

In the dim light of dawn, construction begins on a rocky hill within a city as a winding path and stairs climb the steep slopes. Red cranes lift materials to the summit, where a tall square framework of metal scaffolding rises. Inside the scaffolding, a solid concrete core takes shape. The massive figure of Jesus Christ emerges around the core, standing on a pedestal with arms outstretched. The scaffolding falls away to reveal the completed statue in the bright morning light. The view circles the towering, pale stone figure as it stands atop the rugged peak.

On flat ground next to a city center, a square stone foundation is laid out. Four angled iron piers rise from the corners, supported by wooden scaffolding and tall cranes. The dark iron lattice climbs upward, meeting at a wide first platform before narrowing toward a second tier. As the structure tapers to its top observation deck and pointed spire, the sun sets and casts long shadows across the land. Night falls, and the finished Eiffel Tower suddenly illuminates with bright golden lights that glow through its open metal framework.

In the dark waters beside the shore, two concrete bases appear. Steel frameworks rise from the foundations and throw off bright sparks as the twin towers grow tall. Daylight breaks, and the solid towers turn a bright orange. Thick suspension cables stretch between the peaks and drop down to heavy concrete anchorages on the land. The flat roadway deck extends from the towers and meets in the middle to connect the two shores. As night falls, bright white lights illuminate the suspension cables and the deck while the view circles the glowing bridge.

At night in a city beside a river, a circular patch of ground is cleared and wooden posts are driven into the earth in concentric rings. As daylight breaks, a concrete base covers the site to form a raised circular plaza with a wide staircase. A central steel framework rises from the plaza floor and becomes a multilevel building. An outer geodesic dome made of triangular panels is constructed to enclose the inner structure. As the sun sets, the completed Biosphère stands illuminated from within by a soft blue light, revealing the internal building through its transparent shell.

A circular footprint is marked on a flat patch of grass next to the city's entertainment district. A concrete foundation is poured, and tall cranes erect the steel skeleton of the circular stadium. Tiered seating is installed inside the framework, and a ring-shaped roof is built above the stands. Exterior walls, columns, and access ramps enclose the building as a bright green pitch is laid in the center. As the stadium is completed, the sun sets and night falls. Bright floodlights turn on, illuminating the green field inside while the exterior of the Estádio do Maracanã glows with warm light.

Thick stone retaining walls form a rectangular base in the shallow water just offshore from a coastal city. The enclosure fills with earth and concrete columns support a broad podium as morning daylight brightens the sky. Cranes lift materials into place while tall arched ribs of scaffolding rise from the flat platform in two main clusters. Smooth white shells slide over the curved framework to form the sweeping vaulted roofs. As night falls over the harbor, warm golden lights illuminate the completed Sydney Opera House and reflect off the dark water.

The reef stretches across two tiles in a shallow sea just off a coast. Patches of bright coral in shades of green, blue, and pink cluster beneath the surface of the clear turquoise water. Small sandy shoals emerge among the dense coral formations. Some corals form rounded boulders, while others branch out like underwater bushes. The water deepens to a darker blue around the outer edges of the reef. The view slowly circles the network of aquatic life and reveals the varied shapes of the coral beds.

Three tiles of dark water lie in the open ocean, creating a distinct triangular shape on the surface. The water within this boundary is a very dark navy blue, almost black, forming a stark contrast with the lighter surrounding sea. Within the dark area, a massive whirlpool spins continuously in a clockwise direction. Glowing, bright blue lines trace the circular motion of the currents, appearing and disappearing as they orbit the center. The very heart of the vortex is a deep, dark hole where the swirling water seems to vanish into the depths. The entire anomaly churns steadily, isolated in the vast waters.

The natural wonder covers four inland tiles, where a dense cluster of rounded, conical mounds rises from the landscape. Many of the smooth hills are covered in bright green grass that catches the warm sunlight. Other summits stand completely bare, their surfaces colored a deep and rich brown. Lush green trees and thick tropical vegetation grow in the narrow valleys between the steep slopes, forming a dark canopy at the base of the formation. The view slowly circles the area, revealing the varying heights of the hills and the sharp contrast of the green foliage against the brown earth.

A sheer wall of stark white chalk drops vertically into the dark blue sea. Standing on the coast across two map tiles, the long barrier of rock curves slightly against the water. A thick layer of bright green grass carpets the flat top of the formation and grows right up to the sudden edge. Vertical fissures and gray shadows texture the pale face of the cliffs, highlighting the rough surface of the exposed stone. White foam gathers at the base where the ocean waves wash constantly against the bottom of the wall.

A circular body of deep blue water fills a steep volcanic caldera. The rocky inner walls of the crater drop sharply down to the surface and show layers of bare brown stone. Green coniferous trees cover the gentler outer slopes of the rim and cluster along the top edge. Near one side of the lake, a small volcanic cone rises above the water. This cone is known as Wizard Island and features a tiny crater at its peak dotted with more green trees. The view slowly circles the single-tile lake under bright sunlight.

The deep blue water of a two-tile lake fills a steep, rocky depression. Thick white crusts of salt line the irregular shores, forming a solid, uneven ring around the dark water. Small, jagged pillars and rounded mounds of salt rise from the shallows along the edge. The bare, gray and brown rocky banks slope down to meet the bright white mineral deposits. The view slowly circles the long, narrow body of water. The sharp boundary between the deep blue surface and the pale, crusted rim remains visible from every angle.

A freestanding arch of red sandstone rises from a smooth, sloping rock base in a flat desert. The right leg of the formation is thick, and the left leg is much thinner. The two columns curve inward and meet at the top to form a wide horseshoe shape. Bright sunlight from the right highlights the textured surface of the red rock. A dark shadow of the arch stretches across the lighter sandstone base to the left. The view slowly circles the isolated rock formation and reveals its uneven and weathered contours from different angles.

A massive plug of grey rock rises sharply from the center of a single inland tile. The sheer sides of Mato Tipila are formed by hundreds of vertical columns that run straight up to a flat and rugged summit. A steep slope of fallen boulders forms a wide base around the entire formation. Bright green grass and scattered dark pine trees grow across this lower slope, contrasting with the bare stone above. The view slowly circles the towering monolith under a clear sky, highlighting the deep vertical shadows between the stone pillars.

A towering mountain spans three tiles, rising from a broad base of green vegetation into a harsh rocky environment. Steep ridges of dark gray stone angle upward, carved by deep crevices and shadowed valleys. Thick white snow and glacial ice blanket the upper slopes, clinging to the sheer rock faces and filling the high ravines. The jagged summit of Mount Everest pierces the sky, catching the bright sunlight on its highest peaks. Wisps of white cloud blow constantly from the very top, trailing away from the crest in a steady plume. The massive snow-capped ridges cast deep shadows across the lower slopes, highlighting the steep drops and rugged terrain.

Concentric rings of rock and sand form a massive bullseye in the flat desert. The center of the formation is a wide dome of dark stone. Surrounding this central hub, deep valleys of smooth tan sand alternate with steep ridges of dark gray rock. The rough ridges cast sharp shadows across the sandy troughs under the bright sun. The outermost rings break apart into scattered rocky hills and dunes that blend into the surrounding wasteland. The uniform spacing of the ancient geological layers creates a vast circular pattern across the arid terrain.

A massive, dark volcanic mountain rises from a flat expanse of cold tundra. Thick white snow and a broad ice cap cover the upper slopes and fill the rugged crevices of the rock. A dense plume of dark gray ash and smoke billows continuously from the central caldera. The towering ash cloud rises high into the sky and drifts slightly in the wind. Glaciers spill down the steep, rocky sides of the volcano toward the plains below. The dark basalt and bright ice create a sharp visual contrast across the jagged peaks as the view sweeps around the summit.

A circular pool of deep turquoise water lies inland, covering a single tile. A thick grove of lush green vegetation completely surrounds the bright spring. Tall palm trees and leafy bushes grow densely along the edge of the water. The surface of the pool glows with a pale blue light while small ripples disturb the center where the spring bubbles up from the shallow bottom. Dark shadows from the thick canopy of leaves fall across the bright green grass on the banks, and the surrounding trunks reflect in the still water near the edges. The solid wall of foliage forms a continuous ring around the glowing basin.

A volcanic archipelago lies in a shallow sea just off a coast. The seahorse shape of Isabela Island rises from the water, covered in bright green vegetation. Several deep volcanic calderas dot the spine of the island, their hollows casting dark shadows in the sunlight. Steep, rocky cliffs form the rugged coastline, dropping straight down into the blue ocean. The smaller, rounded Fernandina Island sits nestled within the wide curve of Isabela's large bay. Sunlight catches the varied heights of the volcanic peaks across the green landscape.

A dense cluster of dark gray basalt columns steps up from the water onto the shore, occupying two tiles where the land meets the sea. The tightly packed hexagonal pillars form uneven, jagged terraces that slope down toward the ocean. The highest columns stand together like a rugged cliff face on the inland side. Lower columns descend into a stepped shoreline where the shallow water washes against the bare stone. The flat tops of the pillars create a textured surface across the width of the outcropping. Patches of green vegetation cling to the edges of the rock formation where the basalt meets the soil.

Spanning three inland tiles, a rugged plateau of dark gray and brown stone rises above the landscape. Deep fissures and steep rocky ridges carve through the center of the arid terrain. Several small conical mounds dot the uneven ground across the lower elevations. These are mud volcanoes, each topped with a tiny circular crater holding a pool of thick gray mud. The sunlight casts sharp shadows across the dusty earth and the jagged faces of the cliffs. The view slowly circles the desolate formation, showing the clustered craters and the cracked barren surface of the plateau.

A cluster of steep limestone pillars rises from dark blue water in a shallow sea just off a coast. Thick green vegetation covers the uneven tops and clings to the sheer sides of the karsts. The dark gray and brown stone features deep vertical fissures and jagged edges. The view slowly sweeps around the towering formations, revealing the rough texture of the weathered rock. Sunlight catches the bright green canopy on the summits and the scattered shrubs growing from the cliff faces. Calm water surrounds the dark bases of the massive limestone structures.

A wide circular sinkhole opens in the ground on a single inland tile. Dense green jungle vegetation forms a thick ring around the rim of the deep limestone pit, and tall broadleaf trees crowd the very edge of the steep drop. Numerous thin vines hang straight down from the overhanging plants toward the bottom of the shaft. Dark blue water fills the basin far below the surface of the earth. The steep interior walls of the cenote drop vertically into the still pool as shadows from the surrounding forest fall across the rocky sides.

The volcano rises as a mountain from a single tile. Deep gullies carve the dark gray rock on the sides of the broad peak. White snow and thick ice fields cling to the upper reaches and blanket the wide summit. The icy rim of the Kibo caldera encircles a deep inner crater. A thick plume of gray smoke billows from the ash pit in the center of the crater and drifts into the sky. The view sweeps around the summit, showing the sharp contrast between the dark volcanic rock and the bright white snow.

A long, narrow lake fills two map tiles, pinching slightly in the middle to form an hourglass shape. The water displays a deep purplish pink hue that lightens as it approaches the shore. A thick, irregular crust of bright white salt rings the entire shoreline and spills outward onto the surrounding land. The view slowly sweeps in a circle around the elongated lake, revealing the full extent of the wide salt flats. The inner edge of the salt forms a jagged border against the pink water. The smooth surface remains completely still and flat, contrasting sharply with the rough, pale mineral deposits that enclose the lake.

A deep inlet of dark blue water cuts into a high rocky plateau on the coast. Steep gray cliffs rise straight up from the water to form a narrow channel. Green grass and patches of white snow cover the uneven surface of the plateau. On one side of the channel, a massive square rock formation juts out from the cliff face. This flat topped promontory, known as Preikestolen, drops vertically down to the fjord below. The sheer rock walls cast deep shadows across the water, and the narrow inlet opens directly into the sea.

A steep, pyramidal peak rises as a mountain from a single map tile. Thick white snow and ice cling to the upper slopes of the four distinct faces. Below the snowline, jagged ridges of exposed dark gray and brown rock plunge toward the base. Small green pine trees dot the lower edges of the stone where the rock meets the ground. Wispy white clouds drift in a continuous circle around the sharp, pointed summit. The view sweeps around the mountain to reveal its sheer cliffs.

A rocky mountain ridge forms a crescent to enclose a hidden valley across three inland tiles. Dense jungle vegetation and tall palm trees cover the steep outer slopes and spill over the peaks into the interior. Within the secluded bowl, an ancient settlement of ruined stone structures rests on uneven grassy terraces. Some of the light gray stone buildings retain remnants of brown thatched roofs, while others are reduced to bare walls. A small waterfall cascades down a rocky outcrop into a shallow pool at the heart of the ruins. The rugged perimeter completely shields the secret city from the surrounding landscape.

The natural wonder spans two inland tiles, rising as a wide, rocky hill covered in bright white terraces. The pale travertine rock forms a complex series of stepped, semicircular basins that cascade gently down the uneven slope. Inside these natural basins, shallow pools of thermal water glow in a vibrant, light blue. The stark white formations and bright water stand out sharply against the darker, barren grey stone of the surrounding hillside. As the perspective slowly circles the landmark, the sunlight reflects off the calm surface of the numerous pools.

A sprawling four-tile marshland lies inland, covered in a dense layer of green vegetation. Meandering blue waterways and small, still pools break up the thick canopy of trees and shrubs. The clear water reflects the bright daylight, creating a patchwork of blue and green across the wetlands. Flocks of small white birds take flight from the canopy, circling above the landscape before settling back into the trees. The view sweeps slowly around the marsh, showing the intricate network of flooded channels that weave between small islands and dense foliage.

The wonder covers three tiles and lies on a coast opening to the sea. A dense cluster of dark green pine trees stands tightly packed together, forming a dark and uneven canopy over the ground. The view slowly sweeps around the small forest, revealing the pointed tops of the tall conifers. The trees cast short shadows under the bright sunlight, with the outer pines angling slightly outward while the taller center trees rise straight up. This slow rotation highlights the deep green needles and the dense arrangement of the grove.

A massive tabletop mountain rises abruptly from the inland terrain to span four tiles. Sheer vertical cliffs of gray and brown rock form the steep sides of the tepui. The broad summit is entirely flat and blanketed in a layer of dense green vegetation. Several thin waterfalls cascade over the jagged edges of the plateau. The white water drops straight down the tall rock faces to the ground below. The view circles the irregular perimeter of the mountain, highlighting the sharp angles, jutting promontories and deep crevices carved into the stone.

A massive block of steep mountains rises across two inland tiles. The three sharp granite spires of the Torres stand closely together on the right side of the formation. Beside them to the left, the thicker Cuernos peaks present sheer cliff faces and distinct dark tops over lighter gray rock. Bright white snow and ice cling to the deep crevices and high saddles between the jagged summits. Small green trees dot the rocky lower slopes as they descend abruptly to the flat ground below. The view sweeps around the rugged massif, showing the bare stone catching the sunlight from different angles.

A dense cluster of sharp gray rock formations rises from a single inland tile. The towering limestone needles stand closely packed together to create a jagged landscape. Green trees and shrubs grow at the base of the rocks and cling to the narrow crevices between the stone pillars. Sunlight casts deep shadows across the uneven gray surfaces of the spires. The view circles the formation to reveal the sheer vertical drops and the sharp points of the highest peaks. The dark green foliage provides a stark contrast to the pale gray stone of the rugged karst landscape.

A cluster of eroded, reddish-brown rock pillars and ridges rises from the cold tundra to enclose a wide basin. Thick white snow dusts the rugged peaks and settles deep into the vertical crevices of the stone. Patches of bright green vegetation cling to the sheltered lower slopes and spread across the uneven floor of the hollow. The steep rocky walls cast dark shadows across the interior of the basin. The view slowly circles the landscape, highlighting the sharp contrast between the dark red stone, the bright white snow, and the green grass.

A massive monolith of rusty red sandstone covers a single tile and rises abruptly from the desert. Deep vertical fissures and gullies carve into the steep sides of the rock, casting dark shadows that emphasize its rugged texture. The broad top of the formation is uneven, marked by long parallel ridges and shallow depressions that catch the bright sunlight. The view sweeps around the monolith, revealing its oblong shape and the sheer walls that drop straight down to the dusty floor. Scattered boulders gather at the base of the steep cliffs.

A dark, rocky volcano rises from a single map tile. The mountain features two distinct peaks separated by a shallow valley. The taller, active cone of Vesuvius vents a thick, billowing column of gray smoke high into the sky. Beside it stands the jagged, semicircular ridge of Mount Somma, the steep remnant of an older caldera. Patches of green vegetation cling to the lower slopes, contrasting heavily with the dark gray ash and barren rock near the summits. The view slowly circles the smoking peak, highlighting the rugged, uneven terrain of the volcanic complex under bright sunlight.

A cluster of stark white chalk formations rises from a patch of pale ground that covers four tiles of a vast sandy desert. The rocks take the shapes of rounded boulders, tall pinnacles, and top-heavy mushrooms with narrow stems. Several smaller white stones scatter around the bases of the larger monuments. The bright sun casts sharp shadows from the white pillars across the chalky surface, and the wind-sculpted stones contrast sharply with the surrounding yellow sand dunes. The view slowly circles the white rock garden, revealing the varied shapes of the eroded chalk blocks.

A deep valley of gray stone covers two inland map tiles. Steep granite cliffs rise on both sides of the dark green coniferous forest that carpets the valley floor. On the right, the sheer vertical face of Half Dome towers over the trees. Across the valley on the left, the massive rock wall of El Capitan stands above the forested slopes. Thin white waterfalls plunge down the sheer stone faces into the tree canopy below. The tall stone monoliths cast shadows over the dense woods as the sun shines on their smooth gray peaks.

A mountain range spans three tiles, and its peaks and ridges are striped with broad bands of color. The rock formations display layers of deep red, bright orange, pale yellow, and muted green. Sharp, jagged crests rise above deep crevices and sloping valleys. Small green pine trees dot the lower slopes and gather in the narrow ravines between the colorful peaks. The smooth, undulating surfaces of the rock face catch the sunlight, highlighting the distinct horizontal bands that run across the entire formation. The view sweeps around the striped slopes, revealing the complex folds of the layered stone.
